_meta.what: Record positions (1-based, inclusive) of the NAMCS public-use fields the MASQUE ETL needs, transcribed from each year's NCHS public-use file documentation (Section II, 'Record format': item number, field length, file location).
_meta.sourceDocuments: NAMCS 2015, 2016, 2018 and 2019 public-use file documentation, supplied as .docx by the project lead on 27 September 2026. No 2017 documentation was available.
_meta.coding: DIAG1-5: 2015 ICD-9-CM, 5 characters; 2016-2019 ICD-10-CM truncated to 4 characters on the public-use file, implied decimal after the third character, '-' for an inapplicable or masked digit, -9 = blank. PRDIAG1-5: -7 not applicable, 1 = probable/questionable/rule out, 2 = no. SEX: 1 = female, 2 = male (the reverse of NHIS and NHANES). AGE in years, top-coded. CSTRATM: masked clustered stratum marker; CPSUM: sampled provider marker; PATWT: visit weight.
_meta.verification: namcs_prepare.py checks every field against its documented code frame and refuses a file that does not match.
